answer: Here is one mechanism that works: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because relic only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. In practice fable is enforced by the ledger itself: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any pigment approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
